parsed.summary: The PR addresses the issue of duplicate yields in HashedFilesMixin's post_process() method, but it introduces a new set to track processed files, which may have performance implications.

issues.description: The introduction of a set to track processed files may introduce performance overhead, especially for large numbers of files.
